description: Target Largest Contentful Paint under 2.5 seconds
rationale: LCP is the main user-perceived loading metric

description: Target Interaction to Next Paint under 200 milliseconds
rationale: INP replaces FID and measures real-world responsiveness
Layout shifts cause misclicks and a jarring experience

description: Keep initial JS under 500KB and per-route chunks under 200KB
rationale: Bundle size directly drives TTI on slow networks

description: Split code by route with dynamic imports
rationale: Lazy loading defers non-critical code from the critical path

description: Serve responsive images with srcset and modern formats (webp/avif)
rationale: Oversized images are the top cause of slow LCP

description: Avoid N+1 queries — use eager loading or batched selects
rationale: N+1 patterns explode round-trips and saturate DB connections

description: Add indexes to columns used in WHERE, JOIN, and ORDER BY
rationale: Missing indexes cause full table scans at scale

description: Use connection pooling with bounded max connections
rationale: Unpooled connections exhaust DB limits under load

description: Set long Cache-Control max-age with content-hashed filenames
rationale: Immutable hashed assets enable infinite caching safely

description: Enable gzip or brotli on text responses
rationale: Compression cuts transfer sizes by 60-80 percent

description: Never use fs.*Sync or blocking crypto in request paths
rationale: Sync I/O blocks the event loop and kills throughput

description: Debounce or throttle scroll, resize, and input handlers
rationale: Running handlers every frame wastes CPU and blocks paint

description: Virtualize lists over ~100 items with react-window or similar
rationale: Rendering thousands of nodes destroys scroll performance

description: Profile before optimizing — measure to find the real bottleneck
rationale: Intuition is usually wrong about where time is spent
